thread:
elaine: Quick heads-up: scheduling a staged rollout for runtime+router+console tomorrow 22:30 UTC. Need pinlist, sticky policy, and a rollback example. @deploy-bot can you reserve a 60m window?

deploy-bot: Wave reserved: wave-20240615-03, window 60m starting 2024-06-15 22:30 UTC. Canary route will be /canary/wave-20240615-03/*. Run deploy-bot details --wave wave-20240615-03 for metadata.

peter: Proposed pins: runtime=2.3.2, router=1.8.3, console=0.9.6. Fallbacks runtime=2.3.1, router=1.8.1, console=0.9.4. Note runtime 2.3.2 enables batching heuristic B; we should test header opt-in.

miguel: Router note: set sticky_key=kv-id and sticky_ttl=3600 for canary. Inject header x-kv-prefetch=true on canary route to force batching path. Also set X_PREFETCH_MODE=permissive on canary routers.

qa: We'll run EVAL_SAMPLE=120 and DIFF_THRESH=3. Post results to the wave ticket. If diff >3% hold and notify.

sre-oncall: Infra snapshot eu-west: free mem 19%, kv headroom 12%. Recommend prewarm 3 runtime pods and eviction_grace=60s. I'll schedule prewarm 20m before window.

peter: Rollback triggers: auto rollback if 5xx >1.6x baseline for 2m OR p99 /v1/generate >1600ms for 3m OR QA eval diff >3%. Rollback CLI: deploy-bot rollback --wave wave-20240615-03 --to runtime=2.3.1,router=1.8.1,console=0.9.4 --reason="metric_trip"

elaine: Plan: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> manual hold -> 60% for 15m -> full. Start eu-west only, then open us-east if green. Trace TTL=7d, 1% full payload sampling.

deploy-bot: Preflight checklist prepared. Run deploy-bot preflight --wave wave-20240615-03 25m before start. Alerts wired to #eng-sre and #eng-releases.

els: ack (els is oncall alias)

miguel: ack - I'll watch router header propagation and stickiness.

peter: ack - monitoring API metrics and rollbook readiness.

sre-oncall: ack - infra and prewarm covered.

elaine: Thanks all. I'll post the release-note snippet and customer blurb to the wave ticket, re-open with preflight output.
